mechanism: Betamethasone may increase hepatic metabolism of ezetimibe through CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing ezetimibe efficacy; additionally, corticosteroids can elevate cholesterol levels, counteracting ezetimibe's lipid-lowering effects.
action: Monitor lipid panel closely during concurrent use; consider dose adjustment of ezetimibe or alternative corticosteroid if possible; counsel patient on compliance with both medications.
